question: Which of the following is the correct chemical formula of bleaching powder?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CaOCl₂**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **chemical formula for bleaching powder is Ca(OCl)2. **
 
• The **chemical name** for bleaching powder is **calcium hypochlorite. **
 
• Bleaching powder** is made up of one calcium atom, one oxygen atom, and two chlorine atoms.**
 
• Bleaching powder **is a white solid that smells strongly of chlorine**.
 
• It is soluble in water, but impurities make the solution appear unclear.
 
• **Bleaching powder is used for bleaching clothes, disinfecting water, and as an oxidizer in many industries**.
 
• Bleaching powder **is made by passing chlorine gas through a solution of calcium hydroxide, also known as slaked lime.**
 
• The chemical equation for this process is Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 → Ca(OCl)2 + H2O.
